text:
cassie: Quick sync: proposing 'slab' for incremental pricing buckets in the pricing page. Pushed WIP PR and want to add a worked example + minimal SDK header snippets.

jules: Fine with 'slab' if we add a one-line glossary. Don't rename backend fields.

cassie: Glossary line: "Slab = incremental usage bucket used to compute marginal per-unit price." Will add.

priya: Billing ok. Include a worked numeric example and note about rounding (we bill to the cent daily).

cassie: Draft example:
  - slab A: 0-100k tokens @ $0.0008
  - slab B: 100k-1M @ $0.0006
  - slab C: >1M @ $0.00045
  Cost for 1,000,000 tokens = 100k*$0.0008 + 900k*$0.0006 = $0.68

ben: For snippets: show curl with response headers and JS SDK v2 reading res.metadata. Keep short.
jules: Runtime exposes X-Quota-Remaining and X-Rate-Slab today. Docs should use those. @tom?

tom: Confirmed. We can add X-Billing-Rate later but doc should show stable headers. Also add callout about ~30s lag on quota counters.

cassie: Will add header mapping table (header -> meaning -> UI use) and lag callout.

laura: UX request: rename Grafana panel from 'Quota overview' to 'Billing by slab' so customers find it. Docs should mention redirect behavior.
tom: I can rename the panel and keep old permalink working for 90 days. New link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage?panel=slab

cassie: Adding recommended alert: 1h rolling cost delta > $50. Also small embeddings example (1 embedding = 512 units).

ben: Snippets to include:
  ```
  # curl (show headers)
  curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -d '{"model":"rwd/llama-3-small","input":"hello"}'
  # look for: X-Quota-Remaining, X-Rate-Slab
  ```
  ```js
  // JS SDK v2: headers on res.metadata
  const res = await client.completions.create({model: 'rwd/llama-3-small', input: 'hi'});
  console.log(res.metadata['x-quota-remaining']);
  console.log(res.metadata['x-rate-slab']);
  ```

cassie: Migration note: v1 read raw HTTP headers; v2 surfaces them on response.metadata. Link to SDK migration guide in PR.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview-1599 queued. Preview URL will be posted when ready.

laura: I'll review once preview is up and confirm dashboard rename works with redirect.

cassie: Checklist in PR: glossary, worked examples (tokens + embeddings), header mapping, curl+JS snippets, dashboard name + redirect note, alert example, rounding/legal note. Will update PR tonight and ping reviewers.
